SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, not CT pixels). (1) TRAJECTORY + mapped hash params (all hr=0): iter-1 fourier hidden=128 layers=4 lr=1e-2 -> SSIM 0.4729. iter-2 hidden 128->64 -> 0.4943. iter-3 layers 4->3 -> 0.5452. iter-4 lr 1e-2->2e-2 -> 0.5629 = BEST FOURIER. iter-5 lr 2e-2->4e-2 -> 0.3592 REGRESSED. iter-6 audit-fix (A) naf_encoding fourier->hash (Instant-NGP 16-level multi-res hash grid: levels=16 feat_dim=2 log2_size=19 base_res=16 max_res=512 -> 32-dim feature -> SMALL MLP hidden=32 layers=3 lr=2e-2) -> SSIM 0.6715 (PSNR 23.35, params 16.78M) = NEW BEST, hr 0. iter-7 naf_hidden 32->64 (MLP width) -> SSIM 0.6346 FLAT/REGRESSED = MLP-width axis EXHAUSTED. iter-8 naf_hash_feat_dim 2->4 (per-level features, 16x4=64-dim feature) -> SSIM 0.6951 (PSNR 23.37, RMSE 0.003392, params 33.56M, elapsed 1098.4s) = NEW BEST (+0.0236, hr 0) -> richer HASH-FEATURE capacity (not MLP width) is the live SSIM lever. MAPPED hash params so far: feat_dim (2->4, lift) + MLP-width (32<->64, exhausted) probed; hash_levels=16, log2_size=19, base_res=16, max_res=512 still UNTRIED. (2) LIMITER: NAF is REGIME-BOUNDED on DENSE 2304-view Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete -> hr stays 0; audit says the hash fix makes the impl FAITHFUL, real payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks). For SSIM within budget the binding limiter is HASH CAPACITY: iter-8 proved doubling per-level features lifts SSIM, so the multi-res hash grid is still capacity-bound, not decoder-bound. This is the natural next hash-capacity axis after feat_dim (iter-8 lifted along the feature axis; levels lifts along the resolution axis), the most direct test of whether richer hash capacity KEEPS lifting SSIM. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if naf_hash_levels 16->24, SSIM rises above 0.6951 because more multi-res levels give the hash grid finer resolution coverage and a richer feature for the INR within the same per-scene step budget. (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.

The four live knobs in tv_reconstruction are tv_lambda/tv_iterations/tv_lr/tv_clip_max; the clamp is a hard upper f.clamp_(0.0, clip_max) applied EVERY GD step, truncating every voxel mu>clip_max. LEVER MAP (all four live knobs): clip was THE lever (iter-1 0.05->iter-2 0.08 lifted hr 0.133->0.205, +0.072, by un-truncating high-mu bone) but has only been probed UP TO the search-box ceiling 0.08, NEVER beyond it; lambda BRACKETED at optimum 0.001 (up@0.003 iter-3 0.1366, down@0.0005 iter-6 0.1582 both regress); lr BRACKETED (up-2x@0.02 iter-5 0.1873 overshoot, up-1.3x@0.013 iter-7 0.2082 flat); iters 120(918s)/140(1064s)/160(1227s, OVER WALL) -- 160 gave the peak 0.2085 but is wall-illegal, the budget-safe band <=140 caps at ~0.208 within noise. rationale: hammernik_vn-claude-agentic: vn_T=2, vn_n_filters=24, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=1.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_init=fbp, vn_dc_norm=True, vn_checkpoint=True, vn_normalize_filters=False, epochs=6, batch_size=2, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=480, val_n=214, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=hammernik_vn iter-9 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB (CAPACITY re-probe at the now-WORKING shallow depth): vn_n_filters 16 -> 24. BASE = iter-7 (the BREAKOUT + run-BEST: vn_T=2, vn_n_filters=16, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_normalize_filters=False, train_n=480, lr=5e-4, batch_size=2, vn_checkpoint=true, grad_clip=1.0, vn_dc_norm=true, vn_init=fbp). DEPTH IS NOW SETTLED: iter-7 vn_T 5->2 BROKE OUT to SSIM 0.86068 hr 0.154039 (#8 on board); iter-8 vn_T 2->1 REGRESSED to SSIM 0.84581 hr 0.11827 (a single DC step under-powers) -> vn_T=2 IS the unroll-depth optimum (T=8 crashed to 0.667, T=1 under-powers, T=2 wins). KEEP vn_T=2. TRAJECTORY (NUMBERS): iter-1 SSIM 0.80528 (vn_T=5,N_k=16,lam=0.0023,hr0); iter-2 SSIM 0.79195 (N_k 16->24 capacity^ REGRESSED -0.0133, hr0); iter-3 SSIM 0.76820 (lam^ REGRESSED, hr0); iter-4 SSIM 0.73363 (normalize_filters T REGRESSED, hr0); iter-5 SSIM 0.80886 (train_n 200->480 +0.0036, hr0); iter-6 SSIM 0.66729 (vn_T 5->8 REGRESSED -0.142, hr0); iter-7 SSIM 0.86068 hr 0.154039 PSNR 35.53 elapsed 971.2s (vn_T 5->2 BREAKOUT) <- BEST, current N_k=16, train_n=480; iter-8 SSIM 0.84581 hr 0.11827 elapsed 452.3s (vn_T 2->1 REGRESSED). LIMITER / KEY INSIGHT: capacity (vn_n_filters^) AND data (train_n^) were BOTH falsified at the OLD noisy OVER-UNROLLED vn_T=5 regime and have NEVER been tested at the now-working shallow vn_T=2 depth -- the iter-8 falsifier explicitly flagged this as the next move. CHOICE OF KNOB (capacity over data, from NUMBERS): at vn_T=5 vn_n_filters 16->24 REGRESSED -0.0133 (iter-2) while train_n 200->480 gave only +0.0036 (iter-5, near-saturated at 480/579). At vn_T=5 the learned regulariser was a BLUNT over-smoother re-injected 5x via the in-loop projector DC step, so MORE filters made the smoother WORSE; at the clean vn_T=2 denoiser-dominant regime the recon is no longer smoother-bound, so a richer 24-filter bank has headroom to express an EDGE-PRESERVING regulariser instead of collapsing to smoothing. train_n is already near data-saturation (480/579, +0.0036 at full) so capacity is the higher-value re-probe. KEEP train_n=480. MECHANISM: vn_n_filters 16->24 (the solver default capacity) gives the learned filter bank K_i more degrees of freedom; at the working shallow depth where the denoiser shows through, the extra filters can preserve structure/contrast rather than the DC-smoothing they collapsed to at vn_T=5. HYPOTHESIS: with 24 filters at the working vn_T=2 depth, val_ssim rises above the iter-7 BEST 0.86068 and hr clears 0.154039 (the capacity lever falsified-at-vn_T=5 now helps at the shallow depth). FALSIFIER (numeric): if val_ssim <= 0.86068 / hr <= 0.154039 at vn_T=2 with 24 filters, capacity does NOT transfer to the shallow regime either -- 16 filters is the optimum at all depths -- and iter-10 should re-probe the LAST untested data lever (train_n 480->579, full pool) at vn_T=2. BUDGET (HARD 20-min/1200s train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): vn_n_filters 16->24 = ~1.4x per-step RBF/conv cost; iter-7 ran 971.2s total at N_k=16/vn_T=2/train_n=480, so max_train_s=1000 still BINDS the train wall (fewer epochs fit but still past the ep3 convergence point -> fair converged comparison; cf. iter-2 ran N_k=24 fine at 1351s). val_n=214 kept. Total ~= 1000 (train wall) + ~160 (score 214 + figure) ~= 1160s, under the 1800s SLURM kill (>600s margin). MEMORY-SAFE: vn_T=2 x N_k=24 with batch_size=2 + vn_checkpoint=true stays within the 16 GB RTX5000 (iter-2/3/4 all ran N_k=24 at vn_T=5 with no OOM; vn_T=2 is a LIGHTER footprint -- fewer unrolled steps -> less activation memory; far from the hammernik_2017 bs=4 OOM at 72s). grad_clip=1.0 + vn_dc_norm=true retained (VN-family NaN-skip stability; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint overflows the backward otherwise).

rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=1, unet_c=24, itnet_alpha_init=0.0037, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.0001, pretrain_epochs=40, pretrain_patience=40, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=579, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1050, seed=42, rationale=ITER-9 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). DATA LEVER MAXED -> push the CAPACITY lever. ONE KNOB: unet_c 16->24 (denoiser SmallUNet width +50%), funded by trading pretrain_epochs 72->40 (pretrain_patience tracked 72->40, early-stop disabled) to HOLD the HARD 1200s train+score wall. Base=iter-8 (BOARD CHAMPION, NEW #1, SSIM 0.9427/hr 0.4302 @itnet_k=1/train_n=579/ep72). KEEP itnet_k=1 (iter-7 breakout), residual_learning=False (mandatory config-fix), train_n=579 (FULL 579-slice pool, MAXED at iter-8 -> data coverage exhausted). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, hr=metric of record): (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 SSIM 0.4554/hr0 @ep12/tn200/k3; iter-7 0.9414/hr 0.4187 @k1/tn400/ep120 (k=3->1 BREAKOUT); iter-8 0.9427/hr 0.4302 @tn579/ep72 (train_n 400->579 full pool, +0.0115 hr, BEST). CURRENT pretrain_epochs=72, unet_c=16, train_n=579. (2) LIMITER: both DATA levers are exhausted -- itnet_k=1 (iter-7) and train_n=579 full pool (iter-8). The PRIMARY remaining lever pretrain_epochs UP is BUDGET-PINNED: iter-8 ran 1219.7s @ep72/tn579 (max_train_s=1050 backstop fired); at tn579 per-epoch ~12.6s and fixed val+figure ~312s, so pretrain budget = 1200-312 = 888s caps epochs at ~70 -- ep72 is already AT the wall, cannot raise. So the binding in-budget lever is DENOISER CAPACITY (unet_c), the explicit fallback once pretrain_epochs is budget-capped. (3) ONE KNOB: unet_c 16->24, pretrain_epochs traded 72->40 to hold the 1200s wall. (4) HYPOTHESIS: a wider denoiser (c24 vs c16) on the full 579-slice pool lifts val_ssim/hr ABOVE iter-8 0.4302 because the data is now maxed and the c16 SmallUNet may underfit the full anatomical variety; more capacity captures it. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.4302 (flat/down) at unet_c=24/ep40, the c16 denoiser was NOT capacity-limited (the ep40 cut traded away more convergence than the width added, OR the family is saturated at the 0.43 ceiling) -- iter-10 reverts unet_c->16 and documents the champion ceiling. (5) BUDGET: HARD 20-min (1200s) train+score. c24 SmallUNet body conv FLOPs ~2.25x c16 but per-epoch rises ~1.8x (not all cost is conv); ep40 at tn579: 40 * ~12.6 * 1.8 ~ 907s pretrain + 312s fixed val+figure ... trim toward ep40 = ~888s pretrain target. max_train_s=1050 (17.5-min HARD backstop) GUARANTEES the 214-slice per-sample val + figure finish inside the 30-min (1800s) sbatch wall. val_n=214 KEPT (ALL L277 slices), grad_clip=1.0 KEPT. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. rationale: ram_zeroshot-claude-agentic: ram_ckpt_path=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ram.pth.tar, ram_input_norm=fbp_max, ram_clamp_output=True, ram_finetune=False, ram_finetune_epochs=0, ram_finetune_lr=0.0001, ram_disable_multiscale=True, ram_disable_cudnn=False, ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False, ram_sigma=0.005, ram_factor=0.55, ram_post_fbp_blend=0.3, val_n=214, rationale=iter-8 (search-20260619-01) CLEAN CEILING CONFIRMATION + finetune-retirement, toward the iter-20 mandate. BASE_ITER=5 = the BEST inference config (SSIM 0.9071 hr 0.0: ram_input_norm=fbp_max, ram_factor=0.55, ram_post_fbp_blend=0.3, ram_sigma=0.005, multiscale OFF, finetune OFF, deepinv_tomo OFF), empty patch {} -> bit-identical re-run of the best point. RAM is the LAST maxiter-7 solver (other 18 at iter-8). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS not CT pixels): (1) TRAJECTORY + MAPPED LEVERS: SSIM 0.8611->0.8644->0.8968->0.9024->0.9071 (iters 1-5), hr pinned EXACTLY 0.0 throughout; ALL FIVE inference levers swept & exhausted at hr 0.0 -- post-hoc linear blend ram_post_fbp_blend [i2 0.3->0.5], internal prox_l2 DC gain ram_factor [i3 0.55->0.2], denoiser noise-conditioning ram_sigma [i4 0.005->0.02], input-amplitude norm ram_input_norm [i5 adjoint_max->fbp_max], deepinv-tomo DC physics path ram_use_deepinv_tomo [i6 False->True, regression]; the per-slice self-supervised ram_finetune lever is BUDGET-INFEASIBLE (~80s/slice x214 = ~4.7h, 14x over the 1200s HARD budget, TIMED OUT at the prior iter-7 first attempt, solver has NO amortize-once/finetune-subset/train-split mode -> structurally per-sinogram, hoisting it out of the per-slice loop would require editing the FORBIDDEN solver). iter-7 already reverted to the best inference config (SSIM 0.9071, deterministic re-read identical to iter-5: val_score 0.9070974588394165 both). (2) LIMITER: foreign-prior FBP-ceiling on dense Mayo. RAM is a frozen pretrained zero-shot deepinv foundation-model denoiser that never saw real LDCT helical-rebinned 2304-view fan data; on dense full-view Mayo LD-FBP is already a near-complete inversion, so a foreign-prior denoiser can only redistribute/smooth signal, not add LDCT-specific recoverable structure -> its RMSE stays above the LD-FBP floor (~31-33dB PSNR below the floor) -> calibrated headroom pinned at 0.0 (baseline LD-FBP SSIM 0.8078, oracle HD-FBP SSIM 0.9331; best RAM SSIM 0.9071 is below the LD-FBP floor on the RMSE-sensitive metric). (3) ONE KNOB: NONE genuinely-untried in-budget exists -- audited: ram_disable_multiscale True->False would re-enable per-scale physics evals across 214 slices (iter-1 noted multiscale-disabled CUTS per-slice physics evals), pushing the already-985s inference path over the 1200s wall WITHOUT being an inference-quality lever (changes runtime, not whether the foreign prior carries LDCT signal); ram_clamp_output True->False is degenerate on an RMSE-sensitive metric (unclamping can only let pixels drift out of range = neutral-or-worse, non-diagnostic); there is no seed lever (zero-shot single-forward-pass denoiser is deterministic, frozen weights/no sampling -> iter-5 & iter-7 reproduced SSIM 0.9070974588394165 BIT-IDENTICALLY); ram_finetune is budget-infeasible. => iter-8 runs the CLEAN CONFIRMATION: re-run the best inference point (empty patch on BASE_ITER=5) to document RAM as FBP-bounded on dense 2304-view Mayo. (4) HYPOTHESIS: hr stays EXACTLY 0.0 at SSIM 0.9071 (bit-identical determinism). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if this re-run lands hr != 0.0 OR SSIM != 0.9070974588394165, the iter-5/iter-7 reads were NOT stable (non-determinism in the zero-shot path) and the ceiling read must be re-audited; otherwise the FBP-bound ceiling is confirmed for the 3rd time and the finetune lever is retired as budget-infeasible (NOT a negative architectural result). (5) SIZE/BUDGET <=1200s: INFERENCE-ONLY (ram_finetune=False), IDENTICAL compute profile to iter-5/iter-7 (985.9s/989.8s = 16.4 min, ~4.6s/slice x 214 single forward passes + one op-norm power iter), comfortably under the HARD 1200s=20-min budget; ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False avoids extra deepinv-tomo physics evals; ZERO finetune cost (finetune OFF, NOT enabled). sbatch --time=00:30:00 backstop wall (no in-solver wall knob in solver_ram.py). val=ALL 214 L277 slices. (6) no control return. HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geom, per-sample-ps (single-val-ps probe, val-only solver), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277, 321px FOV DEFAULT (no fov=False). NEVER edit ddssl_ldct/ or the solver file.

rationale: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=214, naf_encoding=hash, naf_hash_levels=16, naf_hash_feat_dim=4, naf_hash_log2_size=19, naf_hash_base_res=16, naf_hash_max_res=512, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=32, naf_layers=3, naf_n_iter=3000, naf_lr=0.02, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-8 (search-20260619-01, naf). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, not CT pixels). (1) TRAJECTORY + mapped hash params (all hr=0): iter-1 fourier hidden=128 layers=4 lr=1e-2 -> SSIM 0.4729. iter-2 hidden 128->64 -> 0.4943 (+0.0215). iter-3 layers 4->3 -> 0.5452 (+0.0509). iter-4 lr 1e-2->2e-2 -> 0.5629 = BEST FOURIER. iter-5 lr 2e-2->4e-2 -> 0.3592 REGRESSED. iter-6 audit-fix (A) naf_encoding fourier->hash (Instant-NGP 16-level multi-res hash grid: levels=16 feat_dim=2 log2_size=19 base_res=16 max_res=512 -> 32-dim feature -> SMALL MLP hidden=32 layers=3 lr=2e-2) -> SSIM 0.6715 (PSNR 23.35, RMSE 0.003399, params 16.78M, elapsed 1101s) = NEW BEST, hr 0. iter-7 naf_hidden 32->64 (MLP width) -> SSIM 0.6346 (PSNR 22.90, elapsed 1099s) FLAT/REGRESSED = MLP-width axis EXHAUSTED. MAPPED hash params so far: only MLP-width (hidden 32<->64) probed; the actual HASH-TABLE-CAPACITY knobs (feat_dim=2, hash_levels=16, log2_size=19, base_res=16, max_res=512) are ALL UNTRIED. (2) LIMITER: NAF is REGIME-BOUNDED on DENSE 2304-view Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete -> hr stays 0; audit says the fix makes the impl FAITHFUL, real payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks). For SSIM within budget the binding limiter is HASH-FEATURE capacity: iter-6/7 showed the 32-dim concatenated hash feature decoded by the small MLP saturates at ~0.67 SSIM, and widening the MLP (iter-7) did NOT help -> the bottleneck is the hash FEATURE richness, not the decoder width. (3) ONE KNOB: naf_hash_feat_dim 2->4 (per-level features; from iter-6 BEST cfg: naf_encoding=hash, naf_hidden=32, naf_layers=3, naf_lr=2e-2, naf_hash_levels=16, naf_hash_log2_size=19, naf_hash_base_res=16, naf_hash_max_res=512 ALL UNCHANGED; step count / wall UNTOUCHED = the deferred B-fix). feat_dim 2->4 DOUBLES the concatenated hash feature 16x2=32-dim -> 16x4=64-dim, adding representational capacity at EVERY existing resolution level (denser features per cell) -- the most direct test of whether richer hash capacity (not MLP width, which is exhausted) lifts SSIM. Preferred over hash_levels (16->24, which adds finer resolutions less likely to bind on already-near-complete dense Mayo). (4) HYPOTHESIS: if naf_hash_feat_dim 2->4, SSIM rises above 0.6715 because a richer per-level hash feature gives the INR more capacity to represent the slice within the same per-scene step budget. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.6715, hash CAPACITY is EXHAUSTED in-budget on dense Mayo -- the hash-NAF ceiling here is ~0.67 SSIM (well below LD-FBP ~0.81 cal floor, hr 0), a STRUCTURAL NEGATIVE on dense 2304-view Mayo (regime-bounded; real payoff is the SPARSE benchmarks), document toward iter-20. (5) SIZE to HARD 1200s budget: 214-scene pass, naf_outer_wall_s=1080 (18-min in-solver outer wall = governor) + naf_per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall; naf_n_iter=3000 stays a HIGH CAP so the WALL governs). STEP COUNT KEPT at iter-6 value (per_scene_s 5.0, n_iter cap 3000 UNCHANGED -- raising it is the DEFERRED B-fix; NOT touched). 214x5.0s=1070s ~= 1080s outer wall (measured elapsed 1099-1101s across the hash iters, inside the 30-min sbatch kill). feat_dim 2->4 doubles the input width to the small MLP (in 32->64) plus a slightly bigger per-level gather; per-step cost stays DOMINATED by the fixed 2304-view fan-beam forward+backward, so step count per 5.0s scene stays comparable -- ~free on the wall. val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices), staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (inlined single-val-ps probe -> L277 native ps ~0.73979), bg_target=truth, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override), naf_encoding=hash kept. (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.

(1) TRAJECTORY both per-scan levers + warm-start depth now MAPPED with bracketed interior optima: lr {1e-3 hr0 (drift), 3e-4 hr0.1976 BEST, 1.5e-4 hr0.1207 iter-6 REGRESSED} optimum 3e-4; n_iter {15 hr0.1506, 18 hr0.1976 BEST, 20 hr0.1595 iter-5 REGRESSED} optimum 18; pretrain_epochs {1 hr0, 4 hr0.1976 BEST, 6 hr0.1870 iter-7 REGRESSED} optimum 4. iter-4 (pe4,n18,lr3e-4,unet_c16) hr 0.1976 SSIM 0.9277 PSNR 35.99 RMSE 7.934e-4 elapsed 1235.5s is the joint optimum + run best (BASE_ITER=4). (2) LIMITER: all three scalar levers (lr, n_iter, pretrain_epochs) are spent/wrong-signed at their bracketed optima. Capacity has NEVER been tested at the anchored lr=3e-4/n_iter=18 optimum where the fit refines NEAR the FBP-consistent init. (3) ONE KNOB: unet_c 16 -> 24 (lr=3e-4, n_iter=18, pretrain_epochs=4, grad_clip=1.0, warm_start=True, val_n=214, seed=42 ALL HELD at iter-4 BEST; the 2-subset even/odd angular split is hard-wired in geometry.py::split_angles and is NOT a cfg knob, so it cannot be the lever without editing a shared module -- forbidden). outer_wall_s 1080 -> 1300 is a FORCED anti-truncation consequence of the larger net (not a tuning knob): the per-scene fit time rises with capacity, and at outer_wall_s=1080 per_scene_s=5.05s with only 0.45s margin over the c16 4.60s/scene would silently truncate; 1300 gives per_scene_s=6.07s, comfortably above the expected ~5.5s/scene at c24, so ALL 214 scenes complete 18 steps with NO truncation. (4) HYPOTHESIS: unet_c 16->24 at the anchored lr=3e-4/n_iter=18 optimum lifts hr above 0.1976 (PSNR above 35.99) because a higher-capacity per-scan denoiser carries a richer FBP-consistent prior through the 18-step refine (lr anchors it near the init; this is the refine regime, not drift). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.1976 (no PSNR gain over 35.99), per-scan capacity is NOT the binding constraint at the anchored lr and per-image U-Net N2I ceilings at hr~0.20 on dense 2304-view Mayo -- the half-view info-loss bound (the even/odd split discards half the 2304 views) -> hr 0.1976 @iter-4 is the per-image N2I half-view ceiling; document it (NAF/ram structural-negative class), no further per-image tuning. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min compute, val=ALL 214): unet_c adds U-Net forward/backward per step; the per-step wall is dominated by the c-INDEPENDENT 2304-view FBP forward+adjoint, so the c16->c24 increase is a fraction of each step. Conservative +20% on the c16 fit loop: 985s -> ~1182s; + overhead ~267s (warm-start 4ep + setup/score) = ~1449s compute; + figure ~27s = ~1476s = 24.6 min figure-inclusive, 324s (5.4 min) under the 1800s/30-min SLURM hard wall. Fit loop ~1182s < outer_wall_s=1300 backstop; per-scene ~5.5s < per_scene_s=1300/214=6.07s -> NO truncation. grad_clip=1.0 mandatory (2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise). val_n=214 NOT reduced (protocol). 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False). staged_canonical / v3 mayo_ldct_fitted / per-sample-ps half-angle projector swap / bg_target=truth hard-wired. PER-IMAGE structure UNCHANGED (warm-start pre-pass + per-scan fit; NEVER amortized). (6) no control return.

rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=4, wu_n_outer=1, lr=0.001, epochs=18, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, lambda_neg=1.0, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, seed=42, rationale=wu_2015_trainable iter-8 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). LR-CONVERGENCE iter (framing A: give the gentle lr more steps). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) TRAJECTORY iter->hr: 1->0.0508 (lr0.01,ep6,8params,335s), 2(ep18@lr0.01)->0.0337 (epochs INERT AT lr0.01, hr FELL), 3(n_bands6)->0.0, 4(n_outer2)->0.0 (SSIM 0.6459 COLLAPSED), 5(train_n480,ep3)->0.0411 (data FAILED), 6(lr 0.01->0.003,ep6)->0.0966 NEW BEST (SSIM 0.8232, 334.8s), 7(lr 0.003->0.001,ep6)->0.0668 REGRESSED (SSIM 0.8022, 350.4s). THE lr/EPOCHS INTERACTION: lr0.01->0.003 nearly DOUBLED hr (0.0508->0.0966), but the further drop lr0.003->0.001 at the SAME ep6 REGRESSED to 0.0668 -- at ep6 the smaller lr0.001 UNDER-CONVERGED, it did not reach the basin lr0.003 found in 6 steps. Base copied = iter-7 (lr0.001). (2) LIMITER: the lr0.001 basin is UNDER-CONVERGED at ep6 -- iter-7 fired its own falsifier (hr 0.0668 <= 0.0966 at lr0.001/ep6 => RAISE EPOCHS to let the smaller lr converge BEFORE declaring the lr axis exhausted; do NOT yet file the FBP-ceiling verdict). Note iter-2 proved ep INERT at lr0.01 -- but that is the FAST lr that saturates the clamped scalars by ep1; at the 10x-gentler lr0.001 epochs are NOT presumed inert, they are the missing convergence budget. (3) ONE KNOB: epochs 6 -> 18 (3x) AT lr0.001 (iter-7 base, UNCHANGED). Sole change. PARAM COUNT UNCHANGED at 8 (wu_n_bands=4 + 2 + 2*wu_n_outer=1). wu_n_outer=1 (MANDATORY), grad_clip=1.0, wu_n_bands=4 all held. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if iter-7 was lr0.001-UNDER-CONVERGENCE-limited at ep6, giving it 18 epochs lets lr0.001 settle into a basin that lifts hr ABOVE the iter-6 best 0.0966 (breast-CT TPE precedent: wu hr0.317 at ~10x-lower lr suggests gentler-lr headroom IF converged). PREDICTED iter-8 hr ~0.10-0.13. NUMERIC FALSIFIER (terminal): if hr <= 0.0966 (at/below iter-6 best) EVEN at ep18, then lr0.001 cannot beat lr0.003 even GIVEN 3x the steps -- the lr AND epochs axes are BOTH exhausted; file the FBP-family ceiling verdict (epochs inert, bands regressed, outer-depth collapsed, data failed, lr-floor+epochs exhausted => Wu-trainable caps hr~0.10 on real-helical Mayo, no image-domain learned CNN denoiser, far below dual-domain U-Net families hr~0.27). (5) BUDGET (HARD 1200s/20-min train+score): iter-7 ep6=350.4s. Worst-case PESSIMISTIC (treat ALL 350s as scaling with epochs, over-counts since the 214-slice val pass is a FIXED per-iter cost): 350.4 * 18/6 = 1051s < 1200s HARD and << 1800s SLURM kill; realistically only the train portion scales (val fixed) so ep18 sits well under. val FIGURE outside budget. val_n=214 = ALL L277 slices (do NOT reduce); grad_clip=1.0 (MANDATORY Mayo guard -- 2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise); bs=1 + val_chunk=1 forced by per-sample-ps; staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted; per-sample-ps FBP + per-sample model.proj/model.dense_proj swap; bg_target=truth; 321px detector-geometry FOV default (NO fov override); wu_n_outer=1 (MANDATORY). (6) no control return.

rationale: hammernik_2017-claude-agentic: vn_T=2, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, max_train_s=1050, seed=42, rationale=hammernik_2017 iter-8 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB: vn_T 5 -> 2 (unroll depth DOWN, GENUINELY UNTRIED -- vn_T held at 5 every iter 1-7). BASE_ITER=7 (the BEST + best above-baseline point: SSIM 0.8170, hr 0.0375, vn_T5/ep10/bs1/lr5e-4/lambda0.0023/n_filters16). All else held at iter-7 (vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=5e-4, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, seed=42); max_train_s 1050 kept. TRAJECTORY (corrected metric): iter-1 OOM(bs4); iter-2 0.8012 hr0; iter-3 0.7932 hr0 (lambda 0.0023->0.05 UP REGRESSED); iter-4 0.7828 hr0 (n_filters 16->4 DOWN REGRESSED); iter-5 0.8114 hr0.0319 KEEP (epochs 14->19 UP, FIRST above the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor); iter-6 0.7883 hr0 DISCARD (lr 5e-4->3e-4 DOWN REGRESSED); iter-7 0.8170 hr0.0375 KEEP (batch_size 2->1 DOWN, epochs traded to 10, NEW BEST). best hr=0.0375 @iter-7. MAPPED KNOBS: epochs(UP works), batch_size(DOWN works), lr(DOWN fails), vn_lambda_init(UP fails), vn_n_filters(DOWN fails). NEVER MAPPED: vn_T (unroll depth, held 5 every iter) + train_n (held 200 every iter). LIMITER (box2): OVER-UNROLLING re-injects the learned-regularizer smoothing term Sum_i K_i^T rho_i(K_i y) at every one of the 5 in-loop steps, dragging the FBP init below the floor -- the SAME mechanism that capped the sibling hammernik_vn at hr0 until vn_T 5->2 BROKE IT OUT to hr 0.1540 (and itnet/itnet_v2 via depth k=1). Prior epochs/bs levers only bought +0.006 crumbs to hr~0.037; depth is the unmapped breakout axis. NOT wall-bound: iter-7 ran in only 679.4s of the 1200s budget. ONE KNOB CHOICE (box3): vn_T 5->2 -- the FAMILY-PROVEN BREAKOUT lever (4 breakouts so far: hammernik_vn, itnet, itnet_v2 + the depth-down pattern), genuinely untried in THIS solver. epochs held at 10 (do NOT also raise epochs to spend the freed budget -- that would be a second knob; the headroom is safety margin). HYPOTHESIS (box4): with unroll depth 5->2 the regularizer re-injects 2.5x fewer times so the recon stays near the FBP init -> SSIM clears further above the floor mirroring hammernik_vn 0->0.1540; predict SSIM ~0.84-0.88, hr ~0.08-0.15. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.0375 (<= iter-7 best), depth is NOT this solvers breakout axis (unlike its sibling) -> iter-9 turns to the untried train_n UP data-coverage lever (the proven trainer lever, also unmapped here). BUDGET (box5, HARD 1200s train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): vn_T 5->2 cuts the in-loop unrolled cost ~2.5x, so wall FAR below iter-7 679.4s -- the figure + score(214) stay comfortably in budget; max_train_s=1050 backstop, well under the 1800s SLURM kill. MEMORY-SAFE: vn_T DOWN holds FEWER (B,F,H,W) RBF-bump activation tensors across the unrolled loop than iter-7 -- strictly LIGHTER footprint; batch_size=1 KEPT (OOM-safe minimum; bs=4 OOMed the 16GB RTX5000 at iter-1), N_k=16, grad_clip=1.0 retained (VN-family NaN-skip stability).

DATA-COVERAGE lever on the BOARD CHAMPION. ONE KNOB: train_n 400->579 (FULL 579-slice train pool, ~69%->100% coverage), with pretrain_epochs traded 120->72 + pretrain_patience tracked 120->72 (early-stop stays disabled) to HOLD the HARD 1200s wall AND keep grad-step parity train_n*epochs (iter-7 400*120=48000; iter-8 579*72=41688, ~13% fewer steps as a budget-safety margin since iter-7 overran at 1308.6s). Base=iter-7 (the BREAKOUT, NEW #1, SSIM 0.9414/hr 0.4187 @itnet_k=1/tn400/ep120). KEEP itnet_k=1 (the iter-7 breakout) and residual_learning=False (the mandatory config-fix). MECHANISM (campaign_state.md, CONFIRMED): build_dataset calls load_val_split(split='train', n=train_n) -> a FIXED n-slice subset loaded ONCE; pretrain_denoiser merely reshuffles that subset each epoch (torch.randperm), NO RotatingSubsetDataset. So train_n=400 lets the denoiser see only ~69% of the 579-slice pool (3 ps-groups: 154@0.66192, 98@0.73979, 327@0.77873); train_n=579 raises coverage to 100%. (2) LIMITER: with itnet_k=1 unlocked, the binding limiter is now the TRAINED DENOISER's data coverage -- it only sees ~69% of the anatomy in the 579-slice pool because the fixed-subset loader never rotates. (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 400->579 (full pool), pretrain_epochs traded 120->72 to hold budget; itnet_k=1 KEPT, residual_learning=False KEPT. rationale: ram_zeroshot-claude-agentic: ram_ckpt_path=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ram.pth.tar, ram_input_norm=fbp_max, ram_clamp_output=True, ram_finetune=False, ram_finetune_epochs=0, ram_finetune_lr=0.0001, ram_disable_multiscale=True, ram_disable_cudnn=False, ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False, ram_sigma=0.005, ram_factor=0.55, ram_post_fbp_blend=0.3, val_n=214, rationale=iter-7 (search-20260619-01) PATH B — RETIRE the finetune lever + CONFIRM the FBP-bound ceiling. BASE_ITER=5 (best inference config, SSIM 0.9071 hr 0.0: input_norm=fbp_max, factor=0.55, blend=0.3, sigma=0.005, multiscale off). The prior iter-7 (job 766130) set ram_finetune=True and TIMED OUT: ram.finetune runs PER-SLICE inside the per-slice loop (solver_ram.py L224-243, called at L417 inside for i in range(val_n)) on each slices own y_norm at 35.6M params, ~80s/slice x 214 = ~4.7h, hit the 30-min SLURM wall after ~22 slices, wrote NO row. The solver has NO amortize-once / finetune-subset / train-split knob — finetune is structurally per-sinogram, so PATH A (amortize-then-frozen) is NOT supportable via cfg flags alone (would require hoisting finetune out of the per-slice loop = editing the solver, forbidden). So PATH B: revert ram_finetune=False (pin off), ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False (revert the iter-6 regression probe back to the best inference path), all five inference-scalar levers already mapped at hr 0.0 (blend i2, prox_l2 factor i3, sigma i4, input_norm i5, deepinv-tomo DC path i6), best SSIM 0.9071 @ iter-5. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS not CT pixels): (1) trajectory SSIM 0.861->0.864->0.897->0.902->0.907 (iters 1-5) hr pinned 0.0 throughout; iter-6 deepinv-tomo + iter-7-prev finetune both regressions/timeouts. (2) LIMITER: budget-infeasible per-slice finetune (~80s/slice x214 = 4.7h, 14x over the HARD 1200s budget) + foreign-prior FBP-ceiling: RAM is a frozen zero-shot deepinv denoiser that never saw real LDCT helical-rebinned 2304-view fan data; on dense full-view Mayo LD-FBP is near-complete inversion, the foreign prior only redistributes/smooths -> RMSE stays above the LD-FBP floor (baseline SSIM 0.8078, oracle HD-FBP 0.9331; RAM PSNR ~31-33dB below LD-FBP floor) -> hr pinned 0. (3) ONE knob: ram_finetune True->False (retire the finetune lever; co-revert deepinv_tomo True->False to the best inference path). (4) hypothesis: hr stays EXACTLY 0.0 at SSIM ~0.9071 -- with finetune budget-infeasible AND all five inference levers exhausted, RAM is CONFIRMED structurally FBP-bounded on dense 2304-view Mayo. (5) NUMERIC falsifier: if this clean revert lands hr != 0.0 OR SSIM != ~0.907, the prior iter-5 read was not stable; otherwise the ceiling is confirmed and the finetune lever is retired as budget-infeasible (not as a negative architectural result). (6) no control return. BUDGET ARITHMETIC proving <=1200s: this is INFERENCE-ONLY (ram_finetune=False), identical compute profile to iter-5 (985.9s = 16.4 min, well under the HARD 1200s = 20-min budget). Per-slice cost = ~4.6s/slice x 214 single forward passes + one op-norm power iter = ~985s; ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False avoids the extra deepinv-tomo physics evals so this is at or slightly UNDER iter-5s 985.9s. ZERO finetune cost added (finetune off). sbatch --time=00:30:00 backstop. BEST SSIM 0.8185 (iter-6); hr=0.0 EVERY iter. MAPPED KNOBS: tv_step_init bracketed {1e-2 saturate, 1e-8 passthrough, 1e-5 active-basin}; tv_share_steps {F runaway, T stable}; tv_lr {5e-2 over-drives, 5e-3 stable}; tv_K raised 10->30 ONLY at the FROZEN-step regime (iter-1/2, where it was provably inert). All else IDENTICAL to iter-6 (tv_share_steps=True, tv_step_init=1e-5, tv_lr=5e-3, tv_lambda_init=1e-3, train_n=40, epochs=8, bs=1, tv_clip_max=0.05, tv_eps=1e-6, val_n=214 ALL L277, val_chunk=5, grad_clip=1.0). BUDGET (HARD 20-min train+score = 1200s): tv_K 30->8 STRICTLY LOWERS compute (fewer unroll steps per train+val pass; fixed overhead = data load + 214-slice FBP precompute dominates) -> WELL under iter-6 measured 911.5s, comfortable margin under the 1200s wall; sbatch --time=00:30:00 carries figure/IO headroom. PREDICTED iter-7: SSIM ~0.80-0.86, hr most-likely 0.0 (a single global TV weight over a near-complete inverse is a structurally weak image-domain prior on real LDCT noise, regardless of depth); small chance hr 0.0-0.05 if shallow depth lets a sharper trained step beat the passthrough.

rationale: fast-diffusion recon (pixel domain, unconstrained prior): per-image few-step DC-guided reconstruction from a trained fast-diffusion prior (solver_fast_recon.py, 8-step, FBP init @ t=0.7, eta=1.0, DC=1 CG=5). The 'unconstrained' prior was trained on the larger Mayo train slice pool (vs the 50-slice constrained prior); 'unconstrained' is a misnomer inherited from the demo-dl phantom regime and means MORE train slices, NOT GT leakage (train split only; no val/test). Evaluated on ALL 214 L277 Mayo val slices under the calibrated-SSIM-headroom metric (baseline LD-FBP SSIM 0.8147 / PSNR 34.08 dB; oracle HD-FBP). Result: SSIM 0.8745, PSNR 31.20 dB, calibrated headroom 0.0000. Honest negative on headroom: SSIM clears LD-FBP (0.8147) but the RMSE/PSNR-sensitive calibrated metric keeps PSNR (31.20 dB) below the LD-FBP floor (34.08 dB) on dense (2304-view) rebinned Mayo -> hr pinned at 0.0 (FBP-bounded, below-baseline). Cluster eval run: recon-fast-diffusion-pixel_unconstrained-766045; checkpoint /cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_unconstrained.pt (final_val_flow_loss 0.0162).
advice_for_others: fast-diffusion pixel/unconstrained: on dense full-view Mayo, an 8-step diffusion-prior recon clears FBP on SSIM (0.8745 > 0.8147) but stays PSNR/RMSE-bounded below the LD-FBP floor on the calibrated metric -> hr 0.0; the larger 'unconstrained' train pool lifts SSIM ~0.013 over the constrained prior (0.8615) but does NOT clear the FBP headroom floor on this dense-view geometry.

BASE = iter-6 (the A-fix CG-DC working point, BEST SSIM 0.8241): recon_dc_solver=cg, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=false ALL UNCHANGED. The (A) DC-step CG fix already landed iter-6 (the unconstrained variant got the biggest A-fix gain: soft-DPS best 0.3960 -> CG-DC 0.8241). The (B) v5 DDPM retrain (part ii: full train pool + EMA + DPS-recon selection) is NOT ready -- this iter changes ONLY the NFE knob, reusing ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (200 train slices, NO retrain; "unconstrained"=200-slice misnomer from the demo-dl phantom regime, NOT a leakage variant). TRAJECTORY (val L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV, LD-FBP floor 0.8078): iter-1 T25/eta30/every0 SSIM 0.3688/hr0; iter-2 eta30->5 SSIM 0.3960/hr0 (best soft); iter-3 T25->32 SSIM 0.3869/hr0; iter-4 every0->5 LEGACY hard-DC SSIM 0.0553 (collapse); iter-5 T->40 soft SSIM 0.3709/hr0; iter-6 recon_dc_solver=cg CG-DC SSIM 0.8241/hr0/PSNR27.15 (BEST, the A-fix). LIMITER: regime-bounded on DENSE 2304-view rebinned Mayo -- LD-FBP is near-complete so hr>0 is unlikely from a finer DDIM grid; the coarse T=40 grid is the remaining soft lever and the v4-prior payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks (not this dense-Mayo iter). HYPOTHESIS: a finer DDIM reverse schedule (T 40->56, +40% NFE) lets the CG-DC iterate relax more completely onto the sino-consistent mode, lifting SSIM modestly above iter-6 BEST 0.8241 -- predicted 0.83-0.85, hr STAYS 0 (regime-bound). BUDGET (HARD 20-min=1200s wall, val=evenly-spaced L277): iter-6 ran 961.6s at T=40/val_n=120 = 8.013 s/slice = 0.2003 s/slice/step (CG-DC cost grows ~linearly with T since both DDIM steps and the every-5 CG triggers scale with T). At T=56: 56*0.2003 = 11.22 s/slice; val_n=96 -> 96*11.22 = 1077s = 18.0 min < 1200s (~2 min headroom). val_n=120 at T=56 would be 1346s=22.4min (BLOWS the wall), so val_n=96 is the budget mechanism that unlocks the +40% NFE probe, evenly-spaced across the 214-slice L277 volume (protocol-sanctioned when val_n<214). rationale: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=214, naf_encoding=hash, naf_hash_levels=16, naf_hash_feat_dim=2, naf_hash_log2_size=19, naf_hash_base_res=16, naf_hash_max_res=512, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=64, naf_layers=3, naf_n_iter=3000, naf_lr=0.02, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-7 (search-20260619-01, naf). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, not CT pixels). (1) TRAJECTORY + current hash/MLP cfg (all hr=0): iter-1 fourier hidden=128 layers=4 lr=1e-2 -> SSIM 0.4729 (PSNR 18.55). iter-2 hidden 128->64 -> 0.4943 (+0.0215). iter-3 layers 4->3 -> 0.5452 (+0.0509). iter-4 lr 1e-2->2e-2 -> 0.5629 (PSNR 20.28) = BEST FOURIER. iter-5 lr 2e-2->4e-2 -> 0.3592 REGRESSED (lr lever exhausted). iter-6 audit-fix (A) naf_encoding fourier->hash (Instant-NGP 16-level multi-res hash grid feeding a SMALL MLP hidden=32 layers=3 lr=2e-2) -> SSIM 0.6715 (+0.1086, PSNR 23.35, RMSE 0.003399, params 16.78M, elapsed 1101s, ~scene 214 at the 5.0s per-scene wall) = NEW BEST, hr STILL 0. Current cfg = iter-6 hash: encoding=hash, hash_levels=16, feat_dim=2, log2_size=19, base_res=16, max_res=512, hidden=32, layers=3, lr=2e-2, n_iter=3000(cap), per_scene_s=5.0, outer_wall_s=1080, val_n=214. (2) LIMITER: NAF is REGIME-BOUNDED on DENSE 2304-view Mayo -- LD-FBP is near-complete, so the audit (mayo_campaign_state.md NAF bullet) says the hash fix makes the impl FAITHFUL but is UNLIKELY to clear hr>0 here; the payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks. The audit DEFERS fix (B) (more steps/scene, under-budget) until after the TPE run -- so the step count / wall is OFF-LIMITS this iter. WITHIN that budget the in-budget lever is the hash/MLP hyperparams. iter-6 paired the rich 16-level hash encoder (32-dim concatenated feature, 16.78M params nearly all in the tables) with a DELIBERATELY tiny 32-wide MLP (the reference small MLP). The remaining suspected bottleneck on dense Mayo is the small MLP UNDER-DECODING that 32-dim hash feature. (3) ONE KNOB: naf_hidden 32->64 (naf_encoding=hash, naf_layers=3, all hash table knobs feat_dim/levels/log2_size/base_res/max_res UNCHANGED, lr=2e-2, per_scene_s=5.0, outer_wall_s=1080, val_n=214 ALL UNCHANGED -- step count / wall UNTOUCHED, that is the deferred B-fix). Width 32->64 is a MATMUL-ONLY change (the one hidden->hidden block goes 32x32->64x64 plus the in 32->64 and out 64->1); per-step cost stays DOMINATED by the fixed 2304-view fan-beam forward+backward, so the ~90-100 Adam steps/scene in the 5.0s per-scene wall stay comparable -- the knob is ~free on the wall. Isolates: is the small MLP under-decoding the hash feature on dense Mayo? (4) HYPOTHESIS: if naf_hidden 32->64, SSIM rises above 0.6715 because a wider MLP decodes the 32-dim multi-res hash feature more expressively within the same per-scene step budget. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.6715, the hash/MLP-width hyperparam is EXHAUSTED within the current budget on dense Mayo -- the hash-NAF ceiling here is ~0.67 SSIM (well below the LD-FBP ~0.81 cal floor, hr 0), a STRUCTURAL NEGATIVE on dense 2304-view Mayo (regime-bounded; real payoff is the SPARSE benchmarks), document toward iter-20; the lever then moves to feat_dim or hash_levels. (5) SIZE to HARD 1200s budget: 214-scene pass, outer_wall_s=1080 (18-min in-solver outer wall = governor) + per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall; n_iter=3000 stays a HIGH CAP so the WALL governs). STEP COUNT KEPT at iter-6 value (per_scene_s 5.0, n_iter cap 3000 UNCHANGED -- raising it is the DEFERRED B-fix; I did NOT touch it). 214x5.0s=1070s ~= 1080s outer wall (hit ~scene 214 every iter; measured elapsed 1094-1101s, inside the 30-min sbatch kill). The hidden 32->64 change is ~free on the wall. val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices), staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (inlined single-val-ps probe -> L277 native ps ~0.73979), bg_target=truth, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override), naf_encoding=hash kept. (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.

PREDICTED iter-7: hr ~0.0-0.05 if proj-domain capacity helps; hr<=0 falsifies (bilateral structurally capped on Mayo regardless of domain, only U-Net N2I works).

rationale: hammernik_vn-claude-agentic: vn_T=2, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=1.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_init=fbp, vn_dc_norm=True, vn_checkpoint=True, vn_normalize_filters=False, epochs=6, batch_size=2, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=480, val_n=214, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=hammernik_vn iter-7 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB (UNROLLED DEPTH DOWN, the genuinely-untried direction + family-proven breakout lever): vn_T 5 -> 2. BASE = iter-5 (run-BEST: vn_n_filters=16, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_normalize_filters=False, train_n=480, lr=5e-4, batch_size=2, vn_checkpoint=true, grad_clip=1.0, vn_dc_norm=true, vn_init=fbp). TRAJECTORY (NUMBERS, all hr=0, all <= ~0.84 LD-FBP floor, baseline_PSNR 34.08): iter-1 SSIM 0.80528 (N_k=16,lam=0.0023,vn_T=5); iter-2 SSIM 0.79195 (N_k 16->24 capacity^ REGRESSED); iter-3 SSIM 0.76820 (lam 0.0023->0.05 DC^ REGRESSED); iter-4 SSIM 0.73363 (normalize_filters F->T REGRESSED); iter-5 SSIM 0.80886 (train_n 200->480 -> +0.0036 run-BEST); iter-6 SSIM 0.66729 (vn_T 5->8 depth^ -> REGRESSED HARD -0.142). CAMPAIGN LESSON: the SIBLING unrolled solver itnet_v2 broke out hr 0 -> hr 0.4187 (NEW #1) THIS TICK via itnet_k 3->1 (FEWER DC/unroll steps). Mechanism: over-applied DC steps re-inject the noisy 2304-view LD-FBP adjoint and DEGRADE the recon; fewer steps let the learned denoiser show through. The hammernik_vn analog is vn_T. CRITICAL: vn_T has only EVER been raised (5->8 at iter-6, which crashed SSIM to 0.667) or held at 5 -- NEVER LOWERED. vn_T-DOWN is the GENUINELY-UNTRIED, family-proven direction, AND iter-6 vn_T^ crashing to 0.667 is DIRECT evidence for the over-unrolling/DC-re-injection limiter (more in-loop projector DC steps = more noisy-LD-adjoint re-injection = worse). LIMITER = over-unrolling re-injecting noise (the itnet_v2 mechanism), now evidenced by iter-6. vn_T 5->2 cuts the in-loop PYRO-NN projector DC re-anchoring from 5 to 2 -> less noisy-LD-adjoint re-injection, letting the 16-filter learned regulariser/denoiser dominate. HYPOTHESIS: with fewer DC steps val_ssim jumps PAST the 0.81 FBP-adjacent floor toward/over the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor and hr clears 0 (mirroring itnet_v2 itnet_k 3->1). FALSIFIER (terminal): if val_ssim <= ~0.81 / hr 0 even at reduced vn_T=2, hammernik_vn is CONFIRMED structurally FBP-bounded on rebinned 2304-view Mayo LDCT -- depth-DOWN was the last family-proven lever -- FILE THE NEGATIVE VERDICT and drive remaining iters to DOCUMENT the ceiling. BUDGET (HARD 20-min/1200s train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): vn_T=2 = 0.4x iter-6 per-step DC+RBF cost and 0.4x iter-5 vn_T=5 cost -> FASTER; at train_n=480 with ~2 unrolled steps the per-ep cost drops sharply so max_train_s=1000 still binds with MORE epochs (>3 convergence point -> fair converged comparison). val_n=214 kept. Total well under the 1800s SLURM kill, large margin. MEMORY-SAFE: vn_T=2 x N_k=16 with batch_size=2 + vn_checkpoint=true is the LIGHTEST footprint yet (fewer unrolled steps -> less activation memory; far from the hammernik_2017 bs=4 OOM at 72s). grad_clip=1.0 + vn_dc_norm=true retained (VN-family NaN-skip stability; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint overflows the backward otherwise).

LIMITER: r2gaussian is REGIME-BOUNDED on dense 2304-view Mayo — LD-FBP (~0.808) is near-complete, the inverse is not ill-posed enough for a Gaussian-splat prior to add value, so hr>0 is implausible regardless. Secondary (now FIXED) limiter was cold uniform random-init + pure-L2 loss; iters 1-5 (cold init, L2-only) all landed BELOW the 0.808 FBP init (SSIM 0.68-0.74, hr=0). iter-6 enabled the audit-fix (b) — FBP warm-start (gs_init_from_fbp=True: positions sampled prop to fbp^2, amp seeded from FBP intensity) + SSIM loss term (gs_ssim_weight=0.1; the benchmark is SSIM-scored but the loss was pure L2) — and lifted SSIM 0.7383->0.7519 (NEW run-best, +0.0136), hr still 0. HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable in NUMBERS): a slightly stronger SSIM pull (0.1->0.15) toward FBP structure nudges the ~26 completed scenes further AT/ABOVE their FBP init, so the 214-avg SSIM rises modestly above iter-6 0.7519 toward the 0.808 LD-FBP floor. PREDICTION: SSIM in (0.75, 0.78), hr 0 (regime-bounded). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.7519 (no lift over iter-6 best), the FBP-init+SSIM-loss fix is exhausted as an SSIM lever on dense Mayo — fix VALIDATED AS FAITHFUL-BUT-REGIME-BOUNDED (its payoff is the sparse benchmarks). BUDGET: gs_init_from_fbp adds ~0 per-step cost (init only); the SSIM term is one cheap conv-SSIM per step vs the dominating 2304-view projection, so per-step stays ~0.282 s and coverage ~26/214 (same as iter-6, elapsed_s 1131 < 1800 SLURM wall). gs_outer_wall_s=1080 self-truncates before the 30-min kill, val figure excluded. val_n=214 per mandate; staged_canonical / v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geom / per-sample-ps (single-val-ps probe) / bg_target=truth / 321px-FOV-default / gs_render=raster all hard-wired. gs_render stays raster (the splat path is the DEFERRED (a) fix and raises NotImplementedError). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 0.7383 (cold/L2) -> iter-6 0.7519 (warm FBP-init + SSIM@0.1, BEST) -> iter-7 = SSIM weight 0.1->0.15, the does-MORE-SSIM-help test of the authorized audit-fix (b).

This is the clean data-coverage test iter-5 was NOT: iter-5 raised tn 200->300 but cut ep 10->7 -> 2100 steps (broke parity) yet STILL produced the LOWEST RMSE on the whole arc (1.139e-3 vs iter-4 1.416e-3) -> more data drove RMSE DOWN even under-trained, so the data lever was NOT cleanly falsified (the prior iter-6 mis-read iter-5 as falsifying it). At grad-step parity vs iter-4, ANY SSIM/RMSE move is attributable to DATA COVERAGE alone, isolating it from extra optimization. WHY DATA IS NOT INERT: LPD loads a FIXED train_n subset ONCE (build_dataset->load_val_split) then torch.randperm reshuffles that SAME tensor each epoch (no RotatingSubsetDataset), so tn200 only ever showed the net 200/579 distinct slices (35%); tn400 = 69% of the 579-slice patient-balanced pool (groups 154/98/327; group-2 caps 98), adding ~200 genuinely-new slices spanning all 3 train patients -> the campaign DATA-COVERAGE lever, the strongest untried-clean axis. HYP: 69%-vs-35% patient-balanced data coverage at matched optimization lets LPD generalise to held-out L277 better, lifting SSIM toward/above iter-4 0.898 AND pushing RMSE below iter-5 1.139e-3 toward clearing the LD-FBP floor (hr>0 for the first time on LPD Mayo); predict SSIM ~0.90-0.92, hr 0 -> possibly slightly >0. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: SSIM <= 0.898 (iter-4) AND RMSE >= 1.139e-3 (iter-5) with hr still 0.000 => data coverage is NOT the lever even at grad-step parity; LPD is FBP-bounded on dense 2304-view Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete at 2304>>Nyquist, no ill-posedness headroom for the unrolled updates), the SAME mechanism that makes it the 128-view-SPARSE breast/demo CHAMPION yet hr0 on dense Mayo -> documented structural ceiling toward iter-20. ep5 under-train confound bounded: if SSIM DROPS below iter-2 0.864 (ep10/tn200) the epoch cut dominated and tn400 needs a deeper wall, not this budget.

THE V1 BREAKOUT KNOB, never tried on v2. ONE KNOB: itnet_k 3->1 (base=iter-5, the best SSIM 0.7294 @train_n=400/pretrain_epochs=120). All else identical to iter-5 (unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, residual_learning=False KEPT, pretrain_lr=1e-4, pretrain_epochs=120, train_n=400, val_n=214, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42); only max_train_s 1100 (18.3-min HARD backstop, safe because k=1 CUTS the per-sample DC cost to a third so this runs FASTER than iter-5 1410s). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, hr=metric of record): (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 SSIM 0.4554/hr0 @ep12/tn200/k3 170s; iter-2 0.5888 @ep48 345s; iter-3 0.6230 @ep144 744s; iter-4 0.7039 @ep240 1237s; iter-5 0.7294/hr0 @ep120/tn400/k3 1411s (val_psnr 26.87); iter-6 0.6307 @ep144/tn200/k3 (tn revert). MAPPED KNOBS: pretrain_epochs (1->4, diminishing) and train_n coverage (5: +0.0255) -- BOTH at itnet_k=3 the WHOLE time. itnet_k has NEVER been moved off 3. (2) LIMITER: iter-3..6 declared a structural cap but did so while leaving the SINGLE highest-value family-proven lever UNPROBED. The k=3 DC re-projects through the noisy 2304-view adjoint 3x per sample, pulling the denoised image BACK toward the noisy LD-FBP -- OVER-APPLIED fixed DC DEGRADES the recon. BASE = iter-4 BEST family (clip 0.08, lambda 0.001) but at the BUDGET-PROVEN tv_iterations=120 (iter-4 at 160 measured 1227.4s, OVER the 1200s HARD wall; only 120 is reproducible under budget). ONE KNOB: tv_lr 0.01->0.013 (fine grid; all else IDENTICAL to the 120-iter BEST iter-2: tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=120, tv_clip_max=0.08, tv_decay/init/optimizer INERT). SOLVER FACT (read from tv_reconstruction): the ONLY four live knobs are tv_lambda/tv_iterations/tv_lr/tv_clip_max; GD step schedule is step=lr/(1+0.01*it) with decay hard-coded. LEVER MAP (all four live knobs): clip exhausted at top of bound [0.03,0.08] (iter-2); lambda BRACKETED at optimum 0.001 -- up@0.003 regressed (iter-3, 0.1366), down@0.0005 regressed (iter-6, 0.1582); iters-UP@160 lowered RMSE 7.857e-4->7.825e-4 (CONVERGENCE helps) for hr 0.205->0.2085 BUT breached the wall (iter-4, 1227s); lr-UP@0.02 (2x) OVERSHOT (iter-5, 0.1873, RMSE up to 8.036e-4). KEY EVIDENCE: iter-4 proves the data term is mildly UNDER-converged at 120 iters (more steps -> lower RMSE -> higher hr), but buying that convergence via iters breaches budget AND via a 2x lr step overshoots. The UNTRIED lever is the FINE lr grid between the proven-good 0.01 and the overshooting 0.02. HYPOTHESIS: a modest +30 pct step (0.01->0.013), well below iter-5 2x overshoot, counteracts the step-decay enough to converge the data term further within the budget-safe 120 steps -- reaching iter-4-like lower residual (RMSE below 7.857e-4) WITHOUT GD overshoot, so hr rises above iter-4 BEST 0.208547 at ZERO extra compute. PREDICTED iter-7 hr ~0.210. FALSIFIER: if hr<=0.208547 (no gain or regression) then EITHER (a) if hr drops, 0.013 already overshoots and the lr step-size lever is exhausted on BOTH sides of 0.01 (overshoot above, no benefit below since lr-down only slows convergence which iter-4 showed hurts), OR (b) if hr is merely flat, 120-iter convergence at lr~0.01 is already at the TV regularization ceiling and iter-4 +0.003 was within noise -- ~0.21 hr / ~0.924 SSIM is the STRUCTURAL classical-TV ceiling on real Mayo LDCT and ALL FOUR live levers (clip, lambda both ways, iters, lr both ways) are exhausted; STOP convergence-knob tuning. BUDGET: tv_lr is a ZERO marginal-compute knob at the budget-proven tv_iterations=120 -> cost model 31.8+120*7.47=928s (77 pct of 1200s, ~272s margin; +10 pct GPU-contention variance ~1018s, still under the wall). DELIBERATELY keeps tv_iterations=120 (NOT iter-4 160 which breached the HARD wall, six-box rule 5). val = ALL 214 L277 slices unchanged. sbatch --time=00:30:00 SLURM safety net.

rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: val_n=214, val_chunk=5, train_n=40, epochs=8, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, tv_K=30, tv_step_init=1e-05, tv_lambda_init=0.001, tv_share_steps=True, tv_clip_max=0.05, tv_eps=1e-06, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, grad_clip=1.0, rationale=tv_iterative_supervised iter-6 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). BASE_ITER=5 (the stable shared-step config). TRAJECTORY (SSIM/hr): iter-1 K=10 0.2855/0.0; iter-2 K=30 0.2855/0.0 (depth FALSIFIED, byte-identical); iter-3 step=1e-8 0.8137/0.0 (LD-FBP PASSTHROUGH); iter-4 step=1e-5 share=F 0.6949/0.0 (per-step RUNAWAY into clamp); iter-5 step=1e-5 share=T 0.6074/0.0 (per-step runaway FIXED but LAMBDA RUNAWAY). BEST hr=0.0 all iters; best SSIM iter-3 0.8137 (pure passthrough). LIMITER (DECISIVE, from iter-5 SLURM log 765433): with tv_share_steps=True the step CONVERGED stable (~3.8e-4, no runaway) and loss flattened at 3.9e-5 (trained, stable) -- BUT the single shared LAMBDA EXPLODED monotonically 0.00123 (ep1) -> 0.119 (ep3) -> 1.328 (ep4) -> 2.527 (ep8), still climbing at the last epoch. At lambda~2.5 with step~3.8e-4 the TV term dominates the data term by orders of magnitude -> the K=30 unroll OVER-SMOOTHS -> SSIM 0.6074 / PSNR 26.84, FAR BELOW the 0.8137 FBP passthrough. The supervised-L2 loss TOLERATES the over-smoothing (3.9e-5 is a fine loss) while SSIM/PSNR collapse. The limiter is NO LONGER step scale (1e-5 is the active basin), NOR depth (falsified), NOR the per-step runaway (share=True killed it) -- it is the UNBOUNDED LAMBDA RUNAWAY under an outer lr that is 10x too aggressive for a 2-scalar log-parametrised optimizer over 8 epochs (lr=5e-2 was RAISED in iter-3/4 to UN-STICK frozen gradients in the share=False regime; it was NEVER LOWERED in the now-stable share=True 2-scalar regime, where it demonstrably over-drives log-lambda by 3 orders of magnitude). ONE KNOB CHANGED (from BASE_ITER=5): lr 0.05 -> 0.005 (10x DOWN). This is a GENUINELY-UNTRIED lever in the share=True regime -- lr-down on the stable 2-scalar config has never been run; it directly counters the observed lambda runaway. All else IDENTICAL to iter-5 (tv_share_steps=True, tv_step_init=1e-5 the confirmed active basin, tv_K=30, train_n=40, epochs=8, bs=1, tv_lambda_init=1e-3, tv_clip_max=0.05, tv_eps=1e-6, val_n=214 ALL L277, val_chunk=5, grad_clip=1.0). HYPOTHESIS: at lr=5e-3 the log-lambda optimizer no longer overshoots -- lambda settles in a moderate band (O(0.01-0.1)) where the K=30 GD balances data-consistency against TV instead of being TV-dominated, so the trained-stable TV recovers ABOVE the 0.8137 FBP passthrough and toward the classical non-trained tv_iterative band (SSIM 0.92 / hr 0.205). NUMERIC FALSIFIER (decisive): if SSIM stays <= 0.8137 with hr=0 -- this RETIRES THE LAST UNMAPPED LEVER and CONFIRMS the structural ceiling: supervised-unrolled-TV is FBP-BOUNDED on real Mayo 2304-view LDCT under the config-only contract -> file the NEGATIVE RESULT and STOP at iter-6. If hr>0, supervised-TV is repaired and iter-7 raises train_n (capacity tiny -- 2 scalars). BUDGET: IDENTICAL compute to iter-5 (~974s, ~226s margin under the 1200s wall). PREDICTED iter-6: SSIM ~0.80-0.88, hr most-likely 0.0 (structurally weak single-global-TV prior on a near-complete inverse); small chance hr 0.0-0.05.

rationale: hammernik_vn-claude-agentic: vn_T=8, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=1.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_init=fbp, vn_dc_norm=True, vn_checkpoint=True, vn_normalize_filters=False, epochs=14, batch_size=2, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=hammernik_vn iter-6 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB (UNROLLED DEPTH, the last untested architectural axis): vn_T 5 -> 8. BASE = iter-1 BEST config (vn_n_filters=16, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_normalize_filters=False, train_n=200; NOT the regressed iter-2/3/4 and NOT iter-5 train_n=480). TRAJECTORY (NUMBERS, all hr=0, ALL <= the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor, baseline_PSNR 34.08): iter-1 SSIM 0.80528 (N_k=16, lam=0.0023, vn_T=5, 1295.7s) <- prior BEST-structural; iter-2 SSIM 0.79195 (N_k 16->24 capacity^ REGRESSED -0.0133); iter-3 SSIM 0.768197 (vn_lambda_init 0.0023->0.05 DC^ REGRESSED -0.0238); iter-4 SSIM 0.73363 (vn_normalize_filters F->T REGRESSED -0.0346); iter-5 SSIM 0.80886 PSNR 32.45 RMSE 1.192e-3 (train_n 200->480 data-coverage -> +0.0036 vs iter-1, but still <0.84, hr 0) <- run-BEST. LIMITER = REGULARISER-DEGRADATION, not under-training: loss flat by ep3 EVERY iter (vs the SIBLING hammernik_2017 which WAS under-trained -- epochs^ cleared ITS floor to hr 0.0375 at iter-7; hammernik_vn has NO such epoch headroom, loss is already converged). The learned VN regulariser term Sum_i K_i^T rho_prime_i(K_i u) acts as a BLUNT SMOOTHER dragging the FBP init below baseline. Capacity (filters), DC-weight (lambda), filter-constraint, AND data-coverage (train_n) are now ALL exhausted -- each either regressed or barely moved. The ONE architectural axis untouched across all 5 iters is the UNROLLED DEPTH vn_T (held =5 every iter). MECHANISM: each unrolled step t applies u <- u - K^T rho_prime - lam*R^T(Ru-g)/dc_norm, i.e. an in-loop PYRO-NN projector data-consistency step. More steps (T 5->8) means the true-projector DC term re-anchors the recon to the MEASURED sinogram 8 times instead of 5 -- the only mechanism in this architecture that can COUNTERACT the per-step regulariser smoothing (the DC pull, applied more often, fights the blunt-smoother regulariser). HYPOTHESIS: with vn_T 5->8 the extra projector-DC re-anchoring lifts val_ssim above the run-best 0.80886 toward the ~0.84 FBP floor (hr>0). FALSIFIER (terminal): if val_ssim stays <= 0.81 (still <FBP, hr=0) even at deeper unrolling, hammernik_vn is CONFIRMED structurally FBP-bounded on rebinned 2304-view Mayo LDCT with ALL architectural axes exhausted (capacity, DC-weight, filter-constraint, data-coverage, AND depth) -> file the NEGATIVE RESULT and drive the remaining iters to DOCUMENT the ceiling toward iter-20, not chase it. BUDGET (HARD 20-min train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): vn_T 5->8 = 1.6x per-step DC+RBF cost. iter-1 ran ~7 ep/1000s at train_n=200,vn_T=5 (~143 s/ep) => at vn_T=8 ~229 s/ep => max_train_s=1000 trips at ~4.4 ep (>3, past the ep3 convergence point -> the converged comparison is fair). train_n REVERTED 480->200 (iter-5 coverage gain was a marginal +0.0036; at train_n=480+vn_T=8 the per-ep ~550s gives <2 ep -> would NOT converge). val_n=214 kept. Total ~= 1000 (train wall) + ~165 (score 214 + figure) ~= 1165s, under the 1800s SLURM kill (~635s margin). MEMORY-SAFE: vn_T=8 x N_k=16 but vn_checkpoint=true gradient-checkpoints each of the 8 unrolled steps (activation memory ~constant in T, NOT 8x) + batch_size=2 keep it within the 16 GB RTX5000 (cf. hammernik_2017 bs=4 OOM at 72s). grad_clip=1.0 + vn_dc_norm=true retained (VN-family NaN-skip stability; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint overflows the backward, and a deeper unroll makes the clip MORE load-bearing).

SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, not CT pixels). (1) PRIOR (val=ALL 214 L277, 321px FOV; hr=metric of record): iter-1 ep8/train_n200 -> SSIM 0.4413 / hr 0.000; iter-2 ep48 -> 0.5927 / hr 0.000; iter-3 ep160 -> 0.6430 / hr 0.000; iter-4 ep220 -> 0.7022 / hr 0.000 (1156.9s, BEST SSIM); iter-5 ep140/train_n300 -> 0.6932 / hr 0.000 (1193.7s). HEADROOM PINNED at 0.000 across ALL 5 iters. iter-5 train_n 200->300 data probe did NOT lift SSIM (0.6932<0.7022, epochs dropped 220->140) and hr stayed 0 -> DATA-COVERAGE is NOT the missing lever. Levers tested: pretrain_epochs (iters 1-4), train_n (iter-5). UNTESTED axis: itnet_k (held =3 every iter). (2) LIMITER = pretrain-then-FIXED-DC ceiling (structural, CONFIRMED from solver_itnet.py read this turn): ItNet.forward lines 76-90 run k DC steps where self.alpha is a PLAIN FLOAT (line 73) and self.projector is FIXED analytic PYRO-NN (line 74) -> ZERO trainable params in the DC unroll; finetune_itnet() (line 114) is DEFINED but NEVER called; main() runs itnet.eval()+torch.no_grad() = pure INFERENCE. The ONLY trainable component is the standalone SmallUNet denoiser (params_M 0.2329) pretrained FBP->truth that NEVER sees the DC steps. The fixed UNTRAINED DC operator drags the recon below the ~0.81 LD-FBP floor regardless of denoiser quality. (3) ONE KNOB: itnet_k 3 -> 1 (fewer FIXED-DC steps). Rationale: itnets OWN documented champion insight is k=1 wins on noisy LDCT (fewer DC steps); since the DC operator here is UNTRAINED and floor-pulling, k=1 passes the well-trained denoiser output through the LEAST harmful fixed-DC correction. This is the clean diagnostic of whether the fixed-DC STEP-COUNT (vs the trainable-param absence) is the floor-puller. Reverts to the iter-4 BEST config (train_n=200) NOT the iter-5 regressed data-trade. pretrain_epochs 220->200 is the budget backstop (NOT a 2nd hypothesis-knob) to hold the HARD 20-min wall conservatively. All else identical to iter-4 (itnet_alpha=0.005, unet_c=16, pretrain_lr=1e-4, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: k=3->1 keeps the recon closer to the well-trained denoiser, SSIM rises modestly above 0.7022 (predict ~0.72-0.78) but hr STAYS 0.000 -- a single fixed-DC step still cannot credit above the ~0.81 floor (denoiser is FBP->truth, FBP-information-capped; the untrained DC adds no params). FALSIFIER (operative): if hr > 0 at k=1, the fixed-DC STEP-COUNT was the floor-puller and itnet_k is the live lever toward 20 (implausible given zero DC params, but the clean discriminator). PREDICTED iter-6 hr = 0.000, SSIM ~0.74. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score): pretrain epochs cost is UNCHANGED by k (DC steps run only at eval, not in pretrain_denoiser); k=3->1 makes the 214-slice val pass CHEAPER (1 DC step/slice vs 3). iter-4 fit: per_epoch(200)=4.21s, fixed=185s. ep200 at train_n=200 -> pred = 185 + 200*4.21 = 1027s = 17.1 min, inside 1200s with ~170s margin (sized DELIBERATELY conservative: doc warns the v2 sibling overran at 1237s; real wall will be BELOW 1027s since val DC is now cheaper; the 30-min sbatch wall is the only hard fence). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside the DC step overflows otherwise). v1 has NO max_train_s backstop. val stays ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (default; NO fov= override). (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. ONE KNOB vs iter-5: train_n 400->200 (the iter-5 falsifier-prescribed revert), with pretrain_epochs traded 120->144 + pretrain_patience tracked 120->144 (early-stop stays disabled) to RESTORE budget headroom after iter-4 (1237s) and iter-5 (1411s) BOTH overran the 1200s budget; this lands exactly on the iter-3 tn200/ep144 point (actual 744.1s) so it doubles as a tn200 reproducibility/ceiling confirmation. max_train_s 1100->900 (15-min HARD backstop) -- deliberately conservative to GUARANTEE the 214-slice per-sample val + figure finish inside the 30-min wall, ending the two-iter overrun streak. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, hr=metric of record): (1) PRIOR NUMBERS / TRAJECTORY: iter-1 SSIM 0.4554/hr 0.0 @ep12/tn200 in 170.2s; iter-2 0.5888/hr 0.0 @ep48 in 345.2s; iter-3 0.6230/hr 0.0 @ep144 in 744.1s; iter-4 0.7039/hr 0.0 @ep240/tn200 in 1236.9s (OVER budget); iter-5 0.7294/hr 0.0 @ep120/tn400 in 1410.6s (OVER budget; val_psnr 26.87, val_rmse 2.267e-3). Best hr=0.0 throughout; LD-FBP floor SSIM ~0.81 sits ABOVE every iter (max SSIM 0.7294 < 0.81), so hr is pinned at 0 by construction. iter-5 result: train_n 200->400 at EQUAL grad-steps (48000) lifted SSIM +0.0255 (0.7039->0.7294) -- the denoiser DID improve with coverage (mirroring uswin/itnet_v3) BUT hr stayed 0.0: the data-coverage lever lifts the denoiser SSIM, NOT hr. (2) LIMITER (CONFIRMED, structural, NUMERIC): the DC stage in solver_itnet_v2.py carries NO trainable params -- pretrain_denoiser optimizes ONLY denoiser.parameters() on (fbp,truth) residual pairs, then ItNetV2 runs itnet.eval() with the k=3 DC operator FIXED (log_alpha never optimized). BINDING KNOB: BOTH in-budget learnable levers are now MAPPED and BOTH saturate below the 0.81 FBP floor -- pretrain_epochs (iter-1->4: 0.4554->0.7039 with sharply diminishing +0.133/+0.034/+0.081 increments, then budget-pinned at 1237s) and data-coverage train_n (iter-5: +0.0255, hr still 0). Neither learnable lever can clear the floor because the un-trained DC coupling caps the family far below end-to-end itnet_v3 (0.91); the DC log_alpha is the only weight that could fix it and it is structurally frozen (solver edits forbidden). (3) ONE UNTRIED KNOB vs CONFIRM CEILING: the two learnable levers are exhausted; itnet_alpha_init/itnet_k shift a FIXED (non-trainable) operator -> near-zero diagnostic value, and pretrain_lr-up is sibling-unstable above 1e-4. Neither learnable lever can clear the floor because the un-trained DC coupling caps the family far below end-to-end itnet_v3 (0.91); the DC log_alpha is the only weight that could fix it and it is structurally frozen (solver edits forbidden). rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_unconstrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=40, recon_eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_dc_solver=cg, val_n=120, train_n=0, rationale=iter-6 search-20260619-01 UNCONSTRAINED diff-recon -- AUDIT CODE-FIX VALIDATION (user-directed 2026-06-20), reuse ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (NO retrain). ONE KNOB: turn ON the CORRECTED hard-DC -- recon_dc_solver legacy->cg + recon_dcstep_every 0->5 (the mechanistic flip; the OTHER dcstep knobs n_cg=3/warmup=5/relax=1.0 are the VALIDATED constrained-iter-6 defaults, not free choices). BASE = the iter-2 BEST non-collapsed soft-DPS working point: recon_eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=false. T 25->40 mirrors the validated constrained-iter-6 reverse schedule (so the unconstrained CG-DC test sits at the SAME T as the working constrained recipe), with val_n=120 as the BUDGET-SIZING mechanism (box 5), NOT a hypothesis variable. The legacy hard-DC path is the bug that COLLAPSED unconstrained iter-4 to SSIM 0.0553 (it is a MISLABELED steepest-descent dressed as CG, plus a re-injection that recomputes x0 from a STALE eps and re-noises with a FRESH randn mid-schedule). recon_dc_solver=cg swaps in a GENUINE Fletcher-Reeves CG solve of AtA x = At y, forms x0 from the CURRENT step eps, CG-projects it, then re-embeds at t_next DETERMINISTICALLY reusing the SAME eps_pred (NO fresh randn, NO stale eps). This is the EXACT fix that lifted the CONSTRAINED sibling iter-5->iter-6 SSIM 0.6647->0.7873 (no collapse, big lift) at this same T=40/val_n=120 working point. TRAJECTORY (val L277, 321px FOV, LD-FBP floor 0.8078): iter-1 T25/eta30/every0 SSIM 0.3688/hr0; iter-2 eta30->5 SSIM 0.3960/hr0 (BEST soft); iter-3 T25->32 SSIM 0.3869/hr0; iter-4 every0->5 LEGACY hard-DC SSIM 0.0553 (COLLAPSE -- the legacy-bug signature); iter-5 T->40 soft SSIM 0.3709/hr0 (T saturated on the PURE-SOFT path). The pure-soft levers (eta, T) are EXHAUSTED on the unconstrained variant; the corrected hard-DC is the last untried mechanism. FAILURE MODE under test: was iter-4's collapse the legacy DC bug (re-noise corruption) -- which the CG path fixes -- or a structural prior-mismatch the CG path also cannot rescue on the soft/unconstrained prior? HYPOTHESIS: if the corrected CG-DC transfers from the constrained sibling (0.6647->0.7873) to the unconstrained soft-DPS prior, SSIM rises well above iter-2 BEST 0.3960 -- predicted 0.55-0.75 -- and does NOT collapse like the legacy iter-4 (0.0553). hr probably STAYS 0 (regime-bounded dense rebinned Mayo: LD-FBP near-complete at 2304 views; the v4 prior payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks + the planned EMA v5). FALSIFIER: if SSIM still COLLAPSES (<<0.39) at recon_dc_solver=cg, there is a RESIDUAL issue in the cg path on the soft/unconstrained prior (e.g. the eta=5 soft gradient + CG re-embed interact differently than the constrained eta=30 + hard-CG path) -> file it and the unconstrained best stays iter-2 (SSIM 0.396, hr 0). BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s wall, val=120 evenly-spaced L277): the VALIDATED constrained iter-6 with the IDENTICAL recon_dc_solver=cg, T=40, every5/n_cg3/warmup5/relax1.0, val_n=120 ran in 963.5 s = 16.1 min < the 1200s/20-min budget (~4 min headroom; the deterministic re-embed drops the legacy randn so the CG path is roughly cost-neutral). val_n=120 held at the constrained iter-6 value for direct sibling comparability. val=120 evenly-spaced L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False). staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps single-val-ps probe, bg_target=truth, reuse ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (NO retrain), 321px FOV.

rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=214, gs_n_gaussians=512, gs_n_iter=150, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_render=raster, gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_amp_init_max=0.05, gs_ssim_weight=0.1, gs_outer_wall_s=1080, rationale=iter-6 (search-20260619-01) PAPER-FIDELITY AUDIT FOLLOW-UP. The directive (a) was to implement the paper's radiative splat-to-detector renderer + Eq.7 rectification. FEASIBILITY VERDICT (in solver FAITHFUL_SPLAT_VERDICT): NOT a tractable net-positive iter here. (i) Rectification is a NO-OP for our forward model -- our solver rasterises the Gaussian mixture into a mu-image then applies PYRO-NN's EXACT discrete X-ray transform (unbiased line integral, no per-Gaussian normalization to omit); Zha's bias only arises in the splat-AND-SUM path, so raster-then-project ALREADY IS the unbiased operator the rectification recovers. (ii) A true 2D fan-beam splatter does NOT reuse PYRO-NN (which exposes only image<->sino on a fixed grid, no per-Gaussian detector-footprint primitive) and needs a custom differentiable EWA kernel -- hundreds of lines, far over the ~150-line one-iter bar. (iii) DECISIVE: the binding constraint is COMPUTE, not fidelity -- iters 1-5 (all hr=0, SSIM 0.68-0.74, all BELOW the 0.808 LD-FBP baseline) show the raster forward already costs ~0.282 s/Adam-step and only 10-64 of 214 slices complete in the 20-min wall; a per-Gaussian-per-view splatter is MORE expensive, so a faithful renderer would cover FEWER scenes and score WORSE. R2Gaussian is regime-bounded on dense 2304-view Mayo (hr~0 regardless); its real payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks. So I SCAFFOLDED gs_render=splat (config-gated, default raster, raises NotImplementedError) + wrote the verdict, and as the ACTUAL iter-6 take the directive's queued CHEAP in-budget lever (the iter+2 fix (b)): enable gs_init_from_fbp=True (was disabled) + add an SSIM loss term (gs_ssim_weight=0.1; benchmark is SSIM-scored). ONE COMPOUND LEVER from iter-1 BEST base (n_iter=150 / 512 Gaussians -- the config that produced the run-best SSIM 0.7383). FAILURE MODE iters 1-5: cold uniform-init Gaussians spend the scarce ~26 completed-scene budget refining a per-scene recon that lands BELOW its 0.808 FBP init, so the 214-average is dragged down by sub-FBP completed scenes. HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable in NUMBERS): FBP warm-start (positions sampled proportional to fbp^2, amp seeded from FBP intensity) + an SSIM pull toward the FBP structure makes the ~26 completed scenes land AT/ABOVE their FBP init instead of below it, so the 214-avg rises toward the 0.808 FBP baseline (from iter-1 0.7383). PREDICTION: SSIM in (0.74, 0.81), hr most likely still 0 (regime-bounded: even matching FBP yields hr=0, and beating dense-Mayo FBP per-scene in 150 Adam steps is implausible). FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.7383 (no lift over iter-1 best), warm-start+SSIM does not rescue the per-scene quality and the dense-Mayo structural ceiling stands -- file the negative result. BUDGET: gs_init_from_fbp adds ~0 per-step cost (init only); the SSIM term adds one cheap conv-SSIM per step vs the dominating 2304-view projection, so per-step stays ~0.282 s and coverage ~26/214 (same as iter-1); gs_outer_wall_s=1080 self-truncates before the SLURM kill, figure excluded, --time=00:30:00 has headroom. val_n stays 214 per mandate; staged_canonical/v3/per-sample-ps(single-val-ps probe)/bg_target=truth/321px-FOV-default all hard-wired. TRAJECTORY: iter-1 0.7383 (cold, 26/214, BEST) -> iter-6 = warm FBP-init + SSIM at the SAME quality/coverage point, the fidelity-clean test of whether warm-start lifts the dense-Mayo ceiling.

FEASIBILITY VERDICT (in solver FAITHFUL_SPLAT_VERDICT): NOT a tractable net-positive iter here. (i) Rectification is a NO-OP for our forward model -- our solver rasterises the Gaussian mixture into a mu-image then applies PYRO-NN's EXACT discrete X-ray transform (unbiased line integral, no per-Gaussian normalization to omit); Zha's bias only arises in the splat-AND-SUM path, so raster-then-project ALREADY IS the unbiased operator the rectification recovers. (ii) A true 2D fan-beam splatter does NOT reuse PYRO-NN (which exposes only image<->sino on a fixed grid, no per-Gaussian detector-footprint primitive) and needs a custom differentiable EWA kernel -- hundreds of lines, far over the ~150-line one-iter bar. (iii) DECISIVE: the binding constraint is COMPUTE, not fidelity -- iters 1-5 (all hr=0, SSIM 0.68-0.74, all BELOW the 0.808 LD-FBP baseline) show the raster forward already costs ~0.282 s/Adam-step and only 10-64 of 214 slices complete in the 20-min wall; a per-Gaussian-per-view splatter is MORE expensive, so a faithful renderer would cover FEWER scenes and score WORSE. R2Gaussian is regime-bounded on dense 2304-view Mayo (hr~0 regardless); its real payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks. So I SCAFFOLDED gs_render=splat (config-gated, default raster, raises NotImplementedError) + wrote the verdict, and as the ACTUAL iter-6 take the directive's queued CHEAP in-budget lever (the iter+2 fix (b)): enable gs_init_from_fbp=True (was disabled) + add an SSIM loss term (gs_ssim_weight=0.1; benchmark is SSIM-scored). ONE COMPOUND LEVER from iter-1 BEST base (n_iter=150 / 512 Gaussians -- the config that produced the run-best SSIM 0.7383). FAILURE MODE iters 1-5: cold uniform-init Gaussians spend the scarce ~26 completed-scene budget refining a per-scene recon that lands BELOW its 0.808 FBP init, so the 214-average is dragged down by sub-FBP completed scenes. HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable in NUMBERS): FBP warm-start (positions sampled proportional to fbp^2, amp seeded from FBP intensity) + an SSIM pull toward the FBP structure makes the ~26 completed scenes land AT/ABOVE their FBP init instead of below it, so the 214-avg rises toward the 0.808 FBP baseline (from iter-1 0.7383). PREDICTION: SSIM in (0.74, 0.81), hr most likely still 0 (regime-bounded: even matching FBP yields hr=0, and beating dense-Mayo FBP per-scene in 150 Adam steps is implausible). FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.7383 (no lift over iter-1 best), warm-start+SSIM does not rescue the per-scene quality and the dense-Mayo structural ceiling stands -- file the negative result. BUDGET: gs_init_from_fbp adds ~0 per-step cost (init only); the SSIM term adds one cheap conv-SSIM per step vs the dominating 2304-view projection, so per-step stays ~0.282 s and coverage ~26/214 (same as iter-1); gs_outer_wall_s=1080 self-truncates before the SLURM kill, figure excluded, --time=00:30:00 has headroom. val_n stays 214 per mandate; staged_canonical/v3/per-sample-ps(single-val-ps probe)/bg_target=truth/321px-FOV-default all hard-wired. TRAJECTORY: iter-1 0.7383 (cold, 26/214, BEST) -> iter-6 = warm FBP-init + SSIM at the SAME quality/coverage point, the fidelity-clean test of whether warm-start lifts the dense-Mayo ceiling.

rationale: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=214, naf_encoding=hash, naf_hash_levels=16, naf_hash_feat_dim=2, naf_hash_log2_size=19, naf_hash_base_res=16, naf_hash_max_res=512, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=32, naf_layers=3, naf_n_iter=3000, naf_lr=0.02, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-6 (search-20260619-01, naf). PAPER-FIDELITY AUDIT FIX (A): add the Instant-NGP multi-resolution HASH encoding (config-gated, user-authorized 2026-06-20). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) NUMBERS trajectory (Fourier-PosEnc path, all hr=0, monotone climb via leanness+lr then a regression): iter-1 hidden=128,layers=4,lr=1e-2 -> SSIM 0.4729 (PSNR 18.55, baseline_PSNR 34.08, ~91 Adam steps/scene at the 5.0s per-scene wall). iter-2 hidden 128->64 -> 0.4943 (+0.0215). iter-3 layers 4->3 -> 0.5452 (+0.0509). iter-4 lr 1e-2->2e-2 -> 0.5629 (PSNR 20.28, RMSE 0.004843) = BEST. iter-5 lr 2e-2->4e-2 -> 0.3592 REGRESSED (lr lever exhausted, short-Adam instability). So iter-6 REVERTS to the iter-4 BEST scalars (hidden 64->32 SMALL MLP per the reference, layers 3, lr 2e-2) and changes the ARCHITECTURE: naf_encoding fourier->hash. (2) FAILURE MODE the fix targets: the Fourier-PosEnc -> vanilla-MLP path is the WRONG inductive bias and is budget-starved (~90-100 steps/scene leaves the coordinate-MLP barely off its water-mu init). The NAF paper's headline contribution is a multi-resolution HASH grid (Instant-NGP) feeding a SMALL MLP -- that is what makes it converge in few steps. The shipped solver had only a plain Fourier PosEnc (audit gap A). (3) ONE KNOB (architecture, user-authorized code fix): naf_encoding 'fourier'->'hash'. New pure-torch HashEncoding: 16 levels, feat_dim 2, log2_hashmap_size 19, base_res 16 -> max_res 512 (geometric: [16,20,25,32,40,51,64,81,102,128,161,203,256,323,406,512]), standard spatial hash h=(ix*1)^(iy*2654435761) mod 2^19, bilinear interp per level, concat -> 32-dim feature -> SMALL MLP (naf_hidden 64->32, naf_layers 3). All other knobs reverted to iter-4 BEST (lr 2e-2, n_freqs 8 unused on the hash path, tv 1e-4, n_clip 0.05). LOCAL+CLUSTER VALIDATION before dispatch: py_compile clean both sides (sha match), and a direct-fit smoke (structured disk-on-bg target) shows the hash path drops loss 99.1% in 60 steps with healthy table gradients (9.1e-5) vs the Fourier path 97.5% -- the hash encoder learns and converges slightly FASTER per step, confirming the code path is correct + the tables are in the autograd graph. (4) HYPOTHESIS: the hash grid's locality + multi-resolution structure converges faster off init than the Fourier MLP in the SAME ~90-100 steps/scene, so SSIM rises above the 0.5629 iter-4 Fourier best. HONEST EXPECTATION (audit): even a FAITHFUL hash-NAF is REGIME-BOUNDED on DENSE 2304-view Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete -> hr likely stays ~0); the hash encoding's real payoff is convergence speed/SSIM here and the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks elsewhere. FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= ~0.56 despite the faithful hash encoder, the per-scene-INR fit is structurally bounded on dense Mayo (document the hash-NAF ceiling as a NEGATIVE result, fix validated as runs+no-regress). (5) HARD 20-min budget UNCHANGED: 214-scene pass, naf_outer_wall_s=1080 (18-min in-solver outer wall = governor) + naf_per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall; naf_n_iter=3000 stays a high cap so the WALL governs). 214x5.0s=1070s ~= 1080s outer wall (hit ~scene 214 every iter; well inside the 30-min sbatch kill). The hash MLP is SMALLER (32 vs 64 hidden) but adds a 16-table gather/step; per-step cost stays dominated by the fixed 2304-view fan-beam forward+backward, so the step count per 5.0s scene is comparable. val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices, NOT reduced), staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (inlined single-val-ps probe -> L277 native ps ~0.73979), bg_target=truth, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override). (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.
